owner_decision: D-03 strict tenant RLS and restricted role approved by explicit user direction 2026-11-07

roles.application: symphony_app (proposed least-privilege runtime role; not provisioned)
roles.purge: separate dedicated purge identity, no ordinary application inheritance

invariants: All tenant_scoped tables require ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY before product use.
Runtime role is not owner, superuser, or BYPASSRLS; no DDL and no DELETE grants.
Every tenant-scoped query uses both RLS and an explicit server-derived tenant predicate.
Global catalogues are SELECT-only for ordinary app role.
Control-plane tables have no ordinary app-role grants; operation-specific grants require a named command, service identity, and audit behavior.
Current migration state is evidence of existing behavior only; two tables currently have ENABLE+FORCE, so WP1.5 must implement and test the rest under real restricted credentials.
